description: Delete a staged upload right away: pass the `url` a `create_file_upload` link returned, with the same workspace `slug`. Use it to revoke a staged `url` that was shared by mistake, or one you no longer need. Only a `url` from a `create_file_upload` link for this workspace is accepted; anything else is refused and nothing is deleted. A `url` that is already gone counts as deleted. Files already in a Files surface are not affected (use `delete_file` for those). Editor role required.

slug.description: The workspace slug (bare or org-prefixed) the upload link was made for.

name: delete_file_upload
